mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_station (id, name, line_name, lat, lng, odr, branch_group) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{lineName}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{odr}, #{branchGroup})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, line_name, lat, lng, odr, branch_group FROM tbl_station WHERE line_name = #{value} AND odr IS NOT NULL ORDER BY branch_group, odr
SELECT id, name, line_name, lat, lng, odr, branch_group FROM tbl_station WHERE line_name IN ('장항선', '경부선', '경인선', '1호선', '중앙선', '경원선') AND odr IS NOT NULL ORDER BY odr, line_name, name
SELECT id, name, line_name, lat, lng, odr, branch_group FROM tbl_station WHERE line_name = '2호선' AND odr IS NOT NULL ORDER BY branch_group, odr
SELECT id, name, line_name, lat, lng, odr, branch_group FROM tbl_station WHERE line_name = '5호선' AND odr IS NOT NULL ORDER BY branch_group, odr
